source.custody: Existing external repository sample used read-only; native producer is not independently established. No external drawing fixture is committed.

authority.documented: The former lists group 177 as the pre-2007 cell override flag and group 140 as the cell text-height override; the latter assigns group 177 a 16-bit integer. Neither establishes native rendering or every bit meaning.

acadsharp.observation: DWG override enum names bit 0x20 TextHeight; the selected original DXF physically pairs group 177 value 32 with group 140 value 4. The DXF reader ignores group 177 and assigns group 140 to a template field; a consumer of that field was not established. This is not independent native semantic validation.
